_style_preset: Semi-realistic Japanese webtoon illustration, crisp bold ink outlines, detailed cel shading, ultra sharp, 16:9

characters.prompt: Create ONE single ultra-sharp, highly detailed illustration in 16:9 widescreen for a YouTube thumbnail — one image only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders. ART STYLE: semi-realistic Japanese drama-manga / webtoon illustration (NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT a chibi avatar): crisp bold black ink outlines on every figure, detailed cel shading with soft gradients, glossy highlights, rich saturated colors, strong warm spotlight and rim light, every face crisp and in focus. SETTING: an elegant upscale Japanese restaurant at night, dark wood walls, warm orange pendant lamps, white tablecloths, a dramatic spotlight beam from above; in the soft background a few shocked diners in suits. COMPOSITION (keep exactly): RIGHT HALF — the old man from reference image 1 (Takamiya Genzo, 78, lean, angular weathered face, close-cropped white hair, short neat white beard, a small mole above his LEFT eyebrow, NO glasses, plain faded grey zip-up jacket) standing tall, seen from the chest up, turned three-quarters toward the viewer, his face LARGE in the upper right of the frame (about 40 percent of the frame height), calm, dignified and stern, eyes looking down to the lower left; slightly low angle so he looks powerful; behind his shoulder a MALE secretary from reference image 3 (a man in his fifties, short neatly combed silver hair, silver-rimmed glasses, black suit, NOT a woman, no hair bun) bowing respectfully. LOWER LEFT, small and in the spotlight on the floor — the restaurant manager from reference image 2 (Iwaki, 45, black hair slicked back, thin black moustache, small black stud earrings, black three-piece suit, silver tie) kneeling in a deep apologetic bow on the floor, hands flat on the floor, face turned up in panic with sweat drops, eyes wide. Keep the UPPER LEFT area (top 55 percent of the left half) relatively plain and dark — dark wood wall and soft bokeh only, no faces there (title text will be added later). Keep the BOTTOM RIGHT corner plain (dark floor). Faces must clearly resemble the reference people; correct anatomy, five fingers per hand, symmetrical eyes. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signs or symbols anywhere — menus and papers are blank. Reference image 4 is a scene still for the kneeling manager's pose only; redraw everything in the illustration style. IDENTITY LOCKS: the old man wears NO earrings and NO piercings at all (both ears bare), has NO sweat on his face, and his jacket is clean plain grey; only the kneeling manager wears small black stud earrings and has sweat drops. The whole canvas is ONE continuous restaurant scene edge to edge: NO white background, NO split panels, NO inset portrait.
